head: Wandrer iOS app is out, plus a Garmin Edge app and new routing
dek: Wandrer, which tracks the new roads you ride, run or walk, has launched its iPhone app, which records activities and shows your new-road progress live. A Garmin Edge app and two new route planners came with it.
details: The Garmin app and data field load your Wandrer map from the cloud and count new roads during a ride, with an Arcade Mode for collecting roads you haven't been on. Point-to-point routing plans an A-to-B route through untravelled roads within the extra distance you allow; another tool plans a route over every road inside a shape you draw. An Android app and destination routing are coming soon. The report doesn't give prices.
where: iPhone now; Garmin Edge bike computers; Android coming soon
means: If you like exploring roads you've never been on by bike or on foot, you can now track them live on your iPhone and on a Garmin Edge.
todo: iPhone users can get the app now. Android users wait for the coming app.
